portfolio.heading: Projects that combine engineering with usability and clear outcomes.
portfolio.lead: These are the challenges I enjoy most: complex products, high UX expectations, and interfaces that support real business goals.

1.title: Crypto Trading Backtester
1.subtitle: A backtester app where trading robots can be created, configured, and evaluated for crypto strategies.
1.description: A backtester application for creating and testing crypto trading robots. Users could define trading logic, configure strategy parameters, and evaluate historical performance before going live.
1.outcome: Enabled strategy experimentation and faster decision-making through a clearer workflow.

2.title: Agricultural Monitoring Platform
2.subtitle: An agricultural app for registering devices and monitoring the values they send from the fields.
2.description: This app let users register field devices and monitor incoming values from remote environments. The interface had to surface device status, measurements, and operational context in an easy-to-understand way.
2.outcome: Improved visibility into field data and device activity with a cleaner monitoring interface.

3.title: Modern CNC Machine Interface
3.subtitle: Modern interfaces for CNC machines, focused on clarity, usability, and operator workflows.
3.description: Implementing modern interfaces for CNC machines where clarity, speed, and operator confidence were essential. The challenge was turning complex machine workflows into interfaces that feel contemporary and efficient.
3.outcome: Delivered a more modern machine-facing experience with better usability and clearer workflows.

4.title: Robotic Application Platform
4.subtitle: An automated platform for building, running, monitoring, and re-deploying collaborative applications.
4.description: An automated platform for building, running, monitoring, and re-deploying collaborative applications. It automates getting a robotic application running, enabling deployment directly on the manufacturing floor with zero programming and zero simulations, in just a few hours.
4.outcome: Reduced deployment complexity for robotics teams and enabled much faster rollout on the floor.

5.title: AI Powered Webshop
5.subtitle: An AI-powered webshop that recommends new or similar products based on user behavior.
5.description: An AI-powered webshop that recommends new or similar products based on user behavior, improving experience and sales through personalized recommendations. We used AWS Personalize to build a recommendation engine trained on a dataset of 5000 products.
5.outcome: Combined modern commerce UX with AI-driven recommendations to improve discovery and relevance.

6.title: Language Exam
6.subtitle: An online language exam web app that lets users take proficiency exams remotely.
6.description: An online language exam web app for taking proficiency exams remotely. Built with Angular on the frontend and ASP.NET Core on the backend, it offers intuitive navigation and responsive design. Users sign up, pick a language and level, and take the exam from any device.
6.outcome: Delivered a reliable remote exam flow with responsive UI and clear task progression.
